name: stage3d_recovery_observability_v1
purpose: Measure whether pre-Geometry evidence makes the marginal value of strong Geometry observable in policy-induced recovery states.

feature_ladder.f1: F0 plus cheap correspondence spatial coverage, entropy, concentration, and retrieval spread
feature_ladder.f3: F2 plus pre-action appearance/change and dynamic/occlusion cues
feature_ladder.extra_network_cost: any segmentation/change network must be charged to the current action; the reference implementation uses ORB only

frozen_controller.memory_terminal_rule: Memory is context only; fresh evidence is required for Accept

evaluation.claim_boundary: fresh temporal diagnostic, not a scene-disjoint final test

next_required_run: Enable --stage3d-preaction-features during online collection, retrain F1/F3, and repeat the audit on a new split; existing ladder numbers were trained with missing optional cues and do not claim an appearance benefit.
